verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents opening and scanning of mail contents, not just envelope images. Mail is opened and scanned in facilities it operates, with high-resolution scans, cloud-stored digital copies, plan-limited free scanning, and a paid expedited-scanning option. However, the evidence never states a turnaround time such as same or next business day, and never says scans are searchable (OCR) PDFs. missing for 10: stated same/next-business-day scan turnaround, explicit searchable/OCR PDF output, independent or hands-on corroboration.
